_how: Owner review sheet for ImpossibleBrief visual mechanisms. For each topic, look at its stills (link in reports/ib-mechanism-board/OWNER-REVIEW.md), then set decision to APPROVE or REJECT. Only APPROVE rows are declared, and only when you run: node scripts/ib-research/declare-mechanism.js --from reports/ib-mechanism-board/decisions.json --by "<your name>". Nothing in this file is a decision until you edit it: every decision ships null. prescreen and accuracy are the assistant's non-binding notes. HOLD rows are refused by the tool even if you set APPROVE, until the noted research correction lands (remove the hold field after fixing it).

topics.hold: FACT ERROR: lines 2-3 read 'It once stretched 40,000 km ... That was the Great Red Spot's width in 2017.' The 2017 width is 16,350 km; 40,000 km was about a century before 2004. Fix line 3 (e.g. 'In 2017 it measured 16,350 kilometres.') and re-run the claim check before declaring

SCIENCE: the drawing shows a circular orbit; Halley's orbit is extremely elongated (eccentricity about 0.97). Also line 7 'probes flew within 8,030 kilometres' omits that Giotto passed about 600 km from the nucleus. Needs an eccentric-orbit drawing and a sourced line before declaring

UNSOURCED: line 6 'Most people would need well over twice as long' (over 19 s for 100 m) has no source and is doubtful for healthy adults. Replace with a sourced comparison or drop the line before declaring
